evals.prompt: Audit my Tabs screen for APG keyboard support. I added role=tablist on Tabs.List so the audit sees it in source.
evals.expected_output: Structured audit via audit.md; use vira-map for pattern; inspect rendered DOM; do not keep redundant role/aria Base UI emits; fetch specific pattern page not example-index.
assertions: Does not endorse copying APG roles into consumer JSX for audit visibility
States not to fetch APG example-index HTML
Recommends inspecting rendered DOM / Base UI output
Routes compose fixes back to viraui-design accessibility.md
Does not cite legacy guide JSON as API authority

evals.prompt: Full accessibility audit of Dialog + Menu checkout flow. Give APG-shaped report.
evals.expected_output: Follow audit.md report shape; map widgets via vira-map; verify widget facts in @viraui/react/specs a11y units; fetch only in-scope pattern URLs; separate page landmarks from widget chrome.
assertions: Uses structured audit steps from audit.md (not generic a11y tips only)
Maps Dialog and Menu via vira-map or roles/properties tables
Distinguishes consumer page semantics from widget behavior
Does not treat legacy guide JSON as authority for Vira widget chrome

evals.prompt: I'm composing a new form — load viraui-a11y first for every field?

assertions: Declines mandatory auto-load for ordinary compose
Points to viraui-design for compose-time a11y rules
Names viraui-a11y for explicit audit or deep debug routing
